newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico to propose eliminating fiscal stimuli - paper.
newsitem.headline: Mexico to propose eliminating fiscal stimuli - paper.

text.p: Mexican Finance Ministry officials, scheduled to meet Wednesday with business leaders, are proposing to eliminate fiscal stimuli incentives in 1998, the daily El Economista said in Wednesday editions.

The government wants to cut incentives next year, particularly to the farm, forestry and transport sectors, to save 0.5 percent of the gross domestic product (GDP), El Economista said, citing unnamed Finance Ministry officials.
Officials and business leaders are to set the agenda for discussions of fiscal reforms for 1998 later Wednesday, El Economista said.
